FDI example data in offlineatlas

National data
fdi_national.csv is a cleaned subset of US_FdiFlowsStock.csv supplied for this
project. It retains country and economy inward flows for 1990-2025, with
missing-value reasons and reporting footnotes. Stocks, outward measures and
73 regional aggregates are excluded. Economy identifiers use a saved
countrycode crosswalk, with an explicit Kosovo mapping. Historical economies
are not reassigned to successors. Missing values are not imputed. The map uses
current US dollar millions and present-day boundaries. The cleaned table also
retains the source's percentage measures.

Bilateral data
fdi_bilateral.csv is a nine-country, 2020-2024 subset derived from the FDI Atlas's
UNCTAD FDI/MNE data. The example uses host-reported inflows, preferring direct
values and then existing mirror reports. Direct zeroes and negative values
are retained. Sample totals are not national totals. The file also retains
comparison fields; the example uses its value and provenance columns.

Source checksums, coverage counts, transformations and national footnotes are
recorded in fdi_metadata.json. These are adapted teaching datasets, not an
unaltered official UNCTAD release. No UNCTAD or United Nations endorsement is
implied. The package's MIT license covers original software and schematic
artwork; it does not replace the FDI data license or Natural Earth notices.
